title: Marlowe Rewards Member Notice — Made-to-Order Deposit Percentages for Long-Standing Members (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders)
content:
**Benefit.** On a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order Reservation, the made-to-order deposit percentage depends on the customer's Marlowe Rewards tier and how long they have been enrolled:

| Marlowe Rewards membership | Made-to-order deposit percentage |
|---|---|
| Active Icon or Atelier, enrolled 36 months or more | 30 |
| Active Gold or Platinum, enrolled 24 months or more | 40 |

For every other customer, membership does not change the made-to-order deposit percentage.

**Records read.** The tier, status and enrolment date of the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership. Months are counted from the enrolment date to today.

**Combinations (hypothetical members)**

| Membership | Months enrolled | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Active Icon | 36 | 30 |
| Active Atelier | 35 | Not changed by membership |
| Active Gold | 24 | 40 |
| Active Platinum | 23 | Not changed by membership |
| Active Icon | 30 | Not changed by membership (the 24-month line belongs to Gold and Platinum) |
| Active Silver | 80 | Not changed by membership |

**Example (hypothetical).** An active Platinum member enrolled 26 months reserves a pair at $300.00. The made-to-order deposit percentage is 40.
